projects.title: Aphid damage detection
projects.subtitle: A closer look at healthier crops.
projects.description: An ongoing, university-funded study on detecting aphid damage in bell pepper plants (Capsicum annuum). Raspberry Pi 5 and YOLOv8n process images, while a Flask web interface shows the results and supports monitoring without an internet connection.
projects.overview: Development of an Edge-IoT-Based Aphid Damage Detection using YOLOv8n and Offline Monitoring using Flask Web Interface for Bell Pepper (Capsicum annuum) on a Raspberry Pi 5. This university-funded research is ongoing.
contributions: Design and develop an edge-IoT system using Raspberry Pi 5 and YOLOv8n for image-based aphid damage detection.
Develop a Flask interface to display detection results and support local monitoring without an internet connection.

projects.title: RT-Spark activity recognition
projects.description: An RT-Thread prototype that streams six-axis accelerometer and gyroscope data over Wi-Fi and MQTT/TLS to a cloud-based walking and running classifier. Python tools capture labeled readings and prepare sensor data for classification.
projects.overview: An RT-Thread prototype streams accelerometer and gyroscope readings over Wi-Fi and MQTT/TLS to a cloud-based walking/running classifier.
contributions: Develop Python tools to capture labeled six-axis inertial readings in CSV.
Prepare sensor payloads compatible with the classification pipeline.
Document exploratory walking and jogging trials using prediction sequences and model confidence.

projects.title: Real-time multisensor room monitor
projects.description: An STM32 Blue Pill room monitor with FreeRTOS tasks for sensors, an OLED display, rotary-encoder input, motion monitoring, and temperature alarms. Queues, event groups, and a serial mutex coordinate the tasks; documentation covers 10 functional checks.
projects.overview: A multisensor room monitor on an STM32 Blue Pill, simulated in Wokwi. Separate FreeRTOS tasks handle sensor acquisition, display, rotary input, motion, and alarms.
contributions: Develop five FreeRTOS tasks for sensing, OLED display, encoder input, motion monitoring, and alarms.
Coordinate tasks with queues, event groups, and a serial mutex.
Document 10 functional checks for sensor updates, navigation, alarms, and activity-state transitions.

projects.title: Smart Inventory Sorting System
projects.description: A desktop prototype for creating, viewing, updating, and deleting product records, with account registration and login. Warehouse occupancy is updated manually across 12 areas.
projects.overview: A software prototype demonstrating an inventory and warehouse management concept using C++17, Qt Widgets, and SQLite. Warehouse occupancy is updated manually in the prototype.
contributions: Co-develop the desktop application and inventory management workflow.
Implement creating, viewing, updating, and deleting product records.
Implement registration, login, and manual occupancy updates across 12 warehouse areas.

projects.title: AquaFlush water-flow monitoring
projects.subtitle: Water-flow monitoring prototype
projects.description: An Arduino Uno prototype that estimates water flow by counting sensor pulses with interrupts. My work included programming, wiring the components, and helping build a miniature drainage model for demonstration.
projects.overview: An Arduino Uno water-flow monitoring prototype built around interrupt-based pulse counting and a miniature drainage demonstration model.
contributions: Program the Arduino Uno to estimate water-flow rates using interrupt-based sensor pulse counting.
Wire electronic components and collaborate on the miniature drainage model.

projects.title: Industrial drying oven control
projects.description: A CODESYS simulation for drying metal fixtures containing heat-sensitive rubber O-rings. PLC logic and HMI screens manage temperature settings, door interlocks, status indicators, overheating alarms, and automatic shutdown.
projects.overview: A CODESYS drying-oven simulation for metal fixtures containing heat-sensitive rubber O-rings, combining PLC control logic and HMI monitoring screens.
contributions: Design and simulate the drying-oven control system.
Develop integrated PLC logic and HMI screens for temperature regulation and monitoring.
Implement adjustable settings, door interlocks, status indicators, overtemperature alarms, and automatic shutdown logic.

projects.title: Touch-sensitive electronic coin tosser
projects.description: A circuit developed through breadboard prototyping and PCB soldering, with 3D models and an animation made in Autodesk Fusion 360. Evaluation covered 50 trials across five potentiometer settings to check LED outputs and circuit behavior.
projects.overview: A touch-sensitive electronic coin tosser developed through breadboard prototyping, PCB assembly, 3D modeling, and structured circuit trials.
contributions: Prototype the circuit on a breadboard and solder components onto a PCB.
Create 3D models and an animation with Autodesk Fusion 360.
Conduct 50 trials across five potentiometer settings to evaluate LED output distribution and circuit behavior.

projects.title: Line-following robot
projects.description: An Arduino Uno (ATmega328P) robot that follows a line using two infrared sensors, an L298N motor driver, and DC motors. I built and documented the hardware.
projects.overview: Built and documented the hardware for an Arduino Uno (ATmega328P) line-following robot, integrating two infrared sensors, an L298N motor driver, and DC motors for autonomous line tracking.
contributions: Build and document the robot hardware.
Integrate two infrared sensors, the L298N motor driver, and DC motors with the Arduino Uno.

projects.title: AVR firmware & simulation
projects.description: AVR assembly exercises covering register operations, stack management, coin-value calculations, and binary search. Work also includes ATmega328P digital inputs and outputs with hexadecimal mapping from 0 to F.
projects.overview: AVR firmware development and simulation coursework, including register operations, stack management, coin-value calculations, binary search, and ATmega328P digital I/O with hexadecimal input mapping from 0 to F.
contributions: Develop AVR assembly programs for register operations and stack management.
Implement coin-value calculations and binary search exercises.
Program and simulate ATmega328P digital I/O with hexadecimal input mapping from 0 to F.

projects.title: BrainBoard quiz game
projects.description: A touchscreen quiz game built with RT-Thread and LVGL on the RA6M3. It combines quizzes, live scoring, and time tracking.

projects.title: STM32 FreeRTOS audio player
projects.description: An STM32F407 audio player that turns binary song selections into synthesized melodies using I2S and DMA. FreeRTOS keeps the playback controls responsive.

experience.org: MSU-IIT FAB LAB Mindanao · Work immersion
experience.text: Operated laser cutters and CNC routers, created 2D designs and 3D models using Autodesk Fusion 360 and Adobe Photoshop, and supported equipment maintenance and STEM projects.
